infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: RaveGuard measures how loud the room is so it can adjust your AirPods' noise protection. Audio is never recorded or sent anywhere.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: RaveGuard reads your AirPods' head motion to notice a fall and to hear you nod during a safety check-in.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RaveGuard shares your location with your chosen contacts only if a safety check-in goes unanswered.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: RaveGuard needs your location while your phone is locked so it can share it with your chosen contacts if a safety check-in goes unanswered. It is never used outside a check-in.
